text:
morgan: Quick status — token-cost attribution pipeline (schema v2.1) is ready for canary but I need owners for ingest deploy + smoke tests. PRs: #4112 (schema), #4118 (ingest), #4120 (smoke). Can we confirm who will own what and a canary window this week?

raj: I can own the ingest deploy, @morgan. Need the clearinghouse merge (PR #4099) merged before I start. ETA for me to do the deploy is tomorrow afternoon.

clara: I'll take smoke tests + dashboard checks. Which sample dataset should I use for the smoke run? Small but covers long-tail routes.

morgan: Use s3://redwood-telemetry/attr-samples/q1-2026/smoke-batch-1 — contains token distributions and a couple of heavy chat sessions. I just uploaded a small subset: smoke-batch-1/mini.jsonl

zane: infra note — canary needs a routing flag flip and a transient autoscaler tweak. I'll add the infra change to a deploy job. snippet: ```yaml
canary: true
route_policy: prefer-canary
autoscale: max_replicas: 6
```

raj: thanks @zane. One question about schema v2.1: we renamed `embeddings.token_count` -> `tokens.user_count`. Is there a fallback in the ingest so older events don't drop?

morgan: yes, ingest transformation will map both fields: `tokens.user_count = tokens.user_count || embeddings.token_count`. It's in PR #4118 under `transform/field_mappings.py`.

telemetry-bot: Canary job created: canary-job-2284501123 by morgan. Status: queued. (auto)

clara: I'll run smoke tests as soon as canary is live. Checklist for me: 1) smoke ingest pass, 2) emb cost attribution sanity, 3) dashboard delta <5% on baseline.

raj: FYI there is one blocking CR on #4118 — minor test flake, I'm +1 after that is fixed. @morgan can you ping the author?

morgan: pinged in PR thread. Author fixed the flake and pushed.

infra-bot: Scheduled canary window: 2026-03-18 22:00-00:00 PST. Nodes: g5.12xlarge pool (burst enabled). Config job ID: infra-cc-7732. (auto)

clara: running the smoke runner now against canary snapshot (mini.jsonl). Quick heads-up — one event showed missing `request.latency_ms` field (schema optional but we use it for bucketed latency). Logging issue in smoke-run-029.

morgan: thanks. raj — can the ingest add a defensive default of latency_ms = -1 for missing values? We can transform to null later in analytics.

raj: yep, will add a small transform. pushing a tiny patch now.

clara: smoke ingest pass ✅. Attribution numbers look sane for the sample (token cost diff <2%). Dashboard comparisons queued, will post screenshots shortly.

morgan: awesome. Final owners summary: ingest deploy = raj, smoke/tests + dashboards = clara, infra config = zane, schema lead = morgan. Next actions: merge #4112 & #4118, kick canary per infra-bot window, clara to validate.

zane: noted. I'll keep the autoscaler relaxed for first 30 minutes then tighten if stable.

morgan: ok closing this thread for now — if any regressions show up, reopen or ping here. Thanks everyone :rocket:
